items.title: Lizzie Miles Interview, 1951-01-18
items.q: And then by them, Benny Carter, the saxophone player. And then, well, they were coming up often. Well, I got to know them.

ctx.x: Did you ever know Albert Wynn? Albert Wynn?

Trombone player. Trombone player, I don't think. You know, I tell you about musicians now. I know gangs of musicians, but not by their name, you see, because it was one of those things where on the job you come in, hello, how you feeling? And that's all, you know, all I know you work where I work at, but I don't know your name, you know, see. But my piano player, usually they, I'd always, would know them, you know. Now, the reason I knew so many of Duke Ellington's boys and I never worked with them, because they…
